newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-OVERMARS POISED TO JOIN ARSENAL, SAYS AGENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-OVERMARS POISED TO JOIN ARSENAL, SAYS AGENT.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam winger Marc Overmars was expected to join English premier league Arsenal on Tuesday, his business representative Yvette Parlevliet said.
The Dutch news agency ANP quoted Parlevliet as saying she expected Overmars to sign a five-year contract.
Ajax would not comment on the report.
Overmars would become the second Dutch international at Arsenal, joining striker Dennis Bergkamp.
